programme.title: Final Approach
programme.desc: Heart-stopping series depicting disastrous airborne accidents.

programme.title: Falling in Love with the Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Bridget Connolly (Patty Duke) and Betsy Lucas (Shelley Long) are two social climbing society women from Santa Catalina Island, California who have been continuous rivals for some unknown reason. But when Betsy's son Mark falls in love with the girl next door—who happens to be Bridget's daughter Theresa—the two women put all of their energy in to planning the wedding, much to the chagrin of their children.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 7: At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: An Unexpected Love
programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: The Circus
programme.desc: Welsh drama. Set in 1848, this is the story of a young girl who is bewitched by the excitement of the travelling circus as it visits her small town in west Wales.

programme.title: Audrey's Rain
programme.desc: Heart-warming drama about a bitter, sharp-tongued spinster, whose future looks bleakwhen she is saddled with raising her nephew and niece after her sister commits suicide. Audrey resents that her family has robbed her of a life of her own, but when her childhood sweetheart reappears on the scene, her life takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.title: Life on Liberty Street
programme.desc: Heartwarming drama with Annabeth Gish. After losing her husband and job, a single mother's life changes unexpectedly while working at a care centre for brain trauma patients.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: With extreme weather and deadly storms threatening to destroy major population centres around the US, head of FEMA, Judith Carr, battles to mitigate the damage and provide relief. Aided by her former college lover, Dr. Ross Duffy, and her father, Senator Ryan Carr, Judith investigates what is casuing the storms and tries to navigate the murky political waters. At the same time, two fake Christian fundamentalists use the disasters to justify stealing first-born children.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: The warming effect is creating new regions of extreme weather, but something else is triggering it; something that when combined with record-breaking heat waves creates explosions in the sky. With time running out, discredited scientist Faith Clavell, teams up with storm chaser Tornado Tommy (Emmy nominee Randy Quaid, "Elvis") and Judith to discover the trigger.

programme.title: Out of the Woods
programme.desc: Drama with Jason London. A self-absorbed young lawyer with ties to the material things in life gets an eye-opening experience when he visits his nature-loving grandfather.

programme.title: Mark Twain's Roughing It
programme.desc: Two-part drama with Robin Dunne. Ageing writer Mark Twain recalls the time he spent as a teenager seeking his fortune in the American West during the Gold Rush years.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's: Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Redeemer
programme.desc: A writer is touched by the story of a former Black Panther who seams to have been wrongfully convicted to life imprisonment 20 years ago. The writer decides to try to help the now middle-aged convict get exonerated.

programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: In 1864, an American Civil War troop struggles to survive when young Union (American Civil War) soldier Jim Rabb (Ryan Merriman) discovers that his mare has given birth to a Colt (horse). A superior officer orders Jim to shoot the foal because it may become a burden, but Jim - seeing the colt as a sign of hope and a reminder of the beauty of life - refuses. The colt remains with the men as they battle. When Confederacy (American Civil War)s overtake the camp and steal the colt, Jim must risk his life retrieving it.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: Drama. A woman moves with her seven-year-old daughter and husband to California from Colorado. After her husband abandons them, she tries to rebuild their lives. Finding solace caring for horses, she decides to enter a horse show.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Charms for the Easy Life
programme.desc: Drama with Gena Rowlands. The story of three women who live in a North Carolina town and defy the traditional roles set forth for them by society.

programme.title: A Bear Named Winnie
programme.desc: Based on the true story behind author A.A. Milne's beloved character, Winnie the Pooh, this is a tale of the remarkable friendship between a Canadian soldier and the cub that stood as a symbol of friendship and hope in a world plagued by war.

programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.desc: Isabella Delarocca is a young Italian who moves to Hollywood determined to succeed as an actress. Isabella begins to teach theater classes and when a colleague of hers is arrested for murder, she decides to investigate on her behalf because she does not believe that he is guilty.

programme.title: The Colour of Magic
programme.desc: The Discworld—a magical realm quite unlike, yet hauntingly familiar to, ours—has got its first tourist Twoflower. Rincewind, an inept ex-student wizard, is given the task of guiding Twoflower through the city state of Ankh-Morpork. Rincewind has two problems: firstly, as an expert coward, he doesn't feel he's the best person to guard a naive—and by local standards extremely rich—tourist through one of the roughest cities in the multiverse. And secondly, the world is coming to an end. Never rains, eh?

programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

The pressure of blending two families while dealing with resentful, escapist, and strung out children takes a back seat when society begins to break down. A forced evolution, and survival of the fittest takes hold, as our dysfunctional family finds they must either reinvent themselves or embrace their darker histories.

It transpires that Cane's boss is Satan himself, come to impregnate a woman on the eve of the new millennium and so bring about the end of days foretold in the Book of Revelation. With the help of his partner, Chicago, Cane now attempts to protect Christine from both Satan and a group of priests who believe that her death is the only way to halt Armageddon.

When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Barselonos „FC Barcelona“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries with Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Investigate a wide range of historically compelling topics and the mysteries surrounding each including the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell, John Wilkes Booth, and more. Each program within the franchise will showcase fresh, new evidence and perspectives including never-before-released documents to the general public, personal diaries and DNA evidence to unearth brand-new information about these infamous and enigmatic chapters in history.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: For centuries. humanity has been fixated on Mars--the glowing red orb in the night sky. As a new era of exploration of the Red Planet begins. we are on the cusp of finally solving the Red Planet's mysteries. Ancient cataclysms are believed to have left Mars barren, but science continues to find clues that this red planet was once blue and capable of producing life. Will we finally uncover evidence of life on Mars. once we finally set foot there? And what else might we discover on this mysterious planet?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
programme.desc: Behind the fierce frontline clashes of WWII, a hidden battle rages — one of espionage, deception, and codebreaking. In rural England, a group of brilliant academics work to crack Germany's "unbreakable" Enigma Code and change the course of the war.

programme.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
programme.desc: Stalingrad. Operation Blue: The German Army fights to take Soviet oil fields and the city of Stalingrad, becoming one of the deadliest battles ever fought and a major turning point on the Eastern Front.

programme.title: Hitler: A Life in Pictures
programme.desc: After the humiliation of the First World War, Hitler was determined to crush communism and create "Lebensraum" or living space for Germany. His ambition drove him to war in a bid for German global domination.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: Our world is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have evolved to survive amid harsh environments, and brutal competition. But in every region resides an elite group of twelve species -- an assembly of mammals, reptiles, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory and defensive skills. They're beautiful, they're highly evolved, and they're dangerous-they are the Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: Australia, a continent unto itself…home to scores of creatures found nowhere else in the world. Among this myriad of species is an elite group of twelve --an assembly of animals, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory skills. Brilliantly adapted, beautiful to observe, they enthrall and amaze us. Now, witness their magnificence by journeying to their inner sanctums. From the Great Barrier Reef to the Outback, to the urban jungle, they creep crawl and live where we live, work, and play. The shows climax comes when it reaches the animal whose size, strength or fearsome reputation looms above all others. To best understand these animals, we not only examine the magnificent adaptations that have allowed them to survive and thrive, but hear from someone whos met them first hand…and lived to tell the story. This first-person narrative offers both stunning detail and insight into why this animal is indeed considered one of the deadliest. Theyre beautiful, theyre highly evolved, and theyre dangerousthey are Australias Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Gaze into the realm of gulpers: animals who waste no time eating their prey — often swallowing it whole. Something deadly lies silent in the leaf litter of West Africa. The Gaboon viper is loaded with the largest fangs and fastest strike of any snake. Further south, the solifuge, or sun spider, darts through the desert, seeking an unlucky bug to mince with its massive mandibles. Strange mouths are also in the ocean. The moray eel is a bizarre fish, but its most characteristic charm is hiding down its dark throat. These and more lie in store.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Examine the weirdest animals that hide deep beneath the soil's surface. A worm explodes from the seabed to yank fish into its mucky pit; a beetle tunnels deep into warm, wet dung; and a miniature digger excavates miles of tunnel with its teeth! Some hunt in swarms to overwhelm living prey, while solo operators rely on disguise and trickery to trap victims. Tunnellers display bizarre and ingenious solutions to survive in cramped, stuffy and dark conditions.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: TV series that captures the wildlife that lives within of Africa. A number of iconic species call the vast biodiversity in this country and help us to understand their natural behaviours in their habitats. Jack Spencer takes us on a journey to look at the amazing communities ranging from a pride of fearsome lions, to a herd of enormous elephants to the smaller insects and everything in between. Each episode has a main focus of one animal group or topic within Africa so for those who enjoy learning about Africa, this programme is for you.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The hyena, much maligned and misunderstood, is no slobbering scavenger. It's a calculating killer: as smart as a primate, as lethal as a lion. Built for the Kill: Hyena follows the transformation of a tiny cub into an accomplished hunter; exposing real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way, the Grumeti and the Mara, each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: It is pure luck to have a genie to fulfill all wishes, to have two of them is something incredible. Leah is a little girl with a genie bottle necklace, which includes Shimmer and Shine, genie twins. Shimmer is a genie with blue eyes and pink hair, encouraging and passionate, she has a pet, a gibbon monkey Tala. Shine is her twin genie with purple eyes and blue hair, big animal lover. Her pet is a little Bengal tiger Nahal. Zac is Leah's neighbor with red hair and blue eyes, and her best human friend. Leah is making three wishes every day, genies are doing their best but the results are far from perfect, as genies are very young and unskilled. This is the source of awkward and comic situations, but in the end girls manage to get over all difficulties.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.desc: Rusty Rivets is a fantastic and picturesque animated series about Rusty who lives in Sparkton Hills along with his friend Ruby Ramirez, a robotic tyrannosaurid named Botasaur, and a group of smaller robots known as the Bits. Rusty is a smart inventor and a little genius who with the help of his amazing discoveries helps his friends out of difficulties. Rusty constructs robots of different sizes, forms and purposes, he is in love with science, technology and engineering. Together with his friend Ruby they can repair any old machinery and out-of-date equipment. Their splendid intellect arouses envy and toxic rivals do not play the game clean.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: King Me/Private and the Winky Factory King Me: King Julien's archrival, Clemson, returns in another attempt to claim the lemur crown. This time the sneaky lemur has a document that "proves" King Julien is not the legitimate king because he wasn't born in Madagascar. A series of challenges to prove who's more kingly ensues, and the penguins try to stack the deck in Julien's favor by each switching brains with him. Simple, right? How could a plan like this possibly fail? Private and the Winky Factory: Private's favorite treat, the Peanut Butter Winky, is going the way of the dinosaur. Distraught that the snack cake is ceasing production, Private urges a raid on the Winky Factory where the last remaining Winkies are rolling off the production line. Impressed by Private's passion, Skipper gives him command of the mission! The young penguin learns there's a heck of a lot to digest when leading a team. programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: This is a story of a simple innocent guy Bijoy (Jeet). He came to Kolkata with his brother. Bijoy met with Puja (Koyel Mallick). Koyel gave shelter to them. Bijoy admitted his brother to Puja's school with the help of Puja. On the other side two anti-socials Bablu Koley (Shankar Chakroborty) & Bindu Masi (Anamika Saha) competing each other for the upcoming vote. Binoy Samanta (Rajatava Dutta) supported Bablu for election. Puja's father Sattabroto Roy (Bodhisatto Majumdar) threatened Bindu Masi. Bindu Masi killed Sattabroto. Bijoy's brother Raju was the only witness of this murder. Puja advised Bijoy to leave the place, but he did not agree. Binu Masi & Bablu Koley tried to kidnap Raju and Raju died. Munna was arrested by Ranabir Roy (Tapas Pal). But Bindu released her brother. Ranabir was suspended. Bijoy killed Munna. Bijoy married Puja. Bijoy killed Bablu Koley. Bindu masi tried to kill Puja, but Bijoy saved her. Binoy told the truth to the press, and Bindu masi killed Binoy.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! So when Squidward tells him that there are a lot of rules that he doesn't know about-like never interrupting Squidward's naps-SpongeBob is eager to learn and follow everything he says. Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: No Hat for Pat: Patrick is sick of all of his friends not being able to play with him because they have to put on their Krusty Krab hats and go to work. So when Mr. Krabs offers him a job as a sign-holder, Patrick is thrilled because it means he gets to wear a hat and work with all his friends! But Pat soon learns that wearing a hat isn't as simple as it looks. Toy Store of Doom: A new toy store has opened up in Bikini Bottom, and SpongeBob and Patrick couldn't be happier! In fact, they are having so much fun at the toy store that they accidentally get locked in when it closes. They soon find out that things are a lot different at the toy store when no one's around...

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! He gets to let loose, fighting the massive Mutanimals Bebop and Rocksteady; even the hug-loving Mondo Gecko joins in on the fun! Raph doesn't hold back, and he gets his butt kicked with a smile on his face. Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. But Raph's dream may become a nightmare, as Raph is oblivious to the fact that he's walked right into their trap!

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: In a world where the Autobots and Decepticons are fighting...Read more for power, a new breed of mutants is caught between the two. These young robots are trying to figure out where they fit in the universe.

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: Determined to stay "chill", Abbey bottles up her feelings and accidentally freezes her friends. // As Meowlowdy and Purrsephone prepare to play a Hissfits show, Meowlody must learn that her unique skills are a strength, not a weakness.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Il castello
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar Robert Redford, James Gandolfini e Mark Ruffalo in un solido dramma carcerario. Recluso in una prigione di massima sicurezza per aver disobbedito a un ordine, il generale Irving, eroe del Vietnam e del Golfo, non può condividere i metodi del direttore della prigione, un colonnello autoritario e crudele. In un continuo crescendo di violenze e ingiustizie scoppia la rivolta dei detenuti, che eleggono Irving come loro capo. La regia è di Rod Lurie, ex critico cinematografico, diplomato alla famosa Accademia Militare di West Point.

programme.title: Benvenuto Presidente!
programme.desc: Claudio Bisio sale al Quirinale nella commedia di Riccardo Milani con Kasia Smutniak. Per un caso di omonimia, un montanaro patito di pesca viene eletto Presidente della Repubblica.

programme.title: Training Day
programme.desc: Oscar a Denzel Washington nell'action di Antoine Fuqua con Ethan Hawke. Un giovane agente deve affiancare per 24 ore un collega veterano nei quartieri più violenti di Los Angeles.

programme.title: Assassinio a Venezia
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo tratto dai romanzi di Agatha Christie di e con Kenneth Branagh. In pensione in Italia, Poirot deve tornare in azione quando durante una seduta spiritica avviene un omicidio.

programme.title: L'ammissione
programme.desc: Tina Fey e Paul Rudd in una divertente commedia. La vita di Portia, responsabile alle ammissioni di Princeton, viene sconvolta quando ritrova John, un ex compagno del college.

programme.title: Night Hunter
programme.desc: Thriller con Henry Cavill, Ben Kingsley e Alexandra Daddario. La polizia e un giudice braccano un inafferrabile serial killer dalla personalità multipla che adesca e uccide le donne.

programme.title: Un bel giorno
programme.desc: Nuova commedia di successo per Fabio De Luigi e Virginia Raffaele. Tommaso, vedovo con quattro figlie, conosce Lara. L'incontro può cambiare tutto, ma entrambi nascondono qualcosa.

programme.title: L'uomo dei ghiacci - The Ice Road
programme.desc: Missione impossibile per Liam Neeson in un action con Laurence Fishburne. Per salvare un gruppo di minatori intrappolati, tre camionisti devono attraversare un lago ghiacciato in primavera.

programme.title: Last Breath
programme.desc: La storia vera di un gruppo di palombari esperti, che sfidano la natura per salvare un compagno di equipaggio rimasto intrappolato a centinaia di metri sotto la superficie dell'oceano.

programme.title: Gran Turismo - La storia di un sogno impossibile
programme.desc: Corse adrenaliniche ispirate a una storia vera che vede al centro il celebre videogame. Un concorso per giocatori di 'Gran Turismo' diventa l'occasione della vita per un ragazzo.

programme.title: Family McMullen, The
programme.desc: Mentre affrontano ostacoli inaspettati, i legami di una famiglia vengono messi alla prova, rivelando la complessità dell'amore e della crescita all'interno di una famiglia.

programme.title: Ti presento Sofia
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia di Guido Chiesa. Un uomo divorziato deve nascondere l'esistenza della figlia per conquistare una donna che detesta i bambini.

programme.title: Night Hunter
programme.desc: Thriller con Henry Cavill, Ben Kingsley e Alexandra Daddario. La polizia e un giudice braccano un inafferrabile serial killer dalla personalità multipla che adesca e uccide le donne.

programme.title: L'uomo dei ghiacci - The Ice Road
programme.desc: Missione impossibile per Liam Neeson in un action con Laurence Fishburne. Per salvare un gruppo di minatori intrappolati, tre camionisti devono attraversare un lago ghiacciato in primavera.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Un appassionante thriller con il Premio Oscar Morgan Freeman e John Cusack ("2012"). Frank Cordell era un sicario al servizio del governo che ha deciso di 'mettersi in proprio'. Arrestato in una piccola citta', riesce a fuggire mentre viene scortato fino a Washington da alcuni agenti dell'FBI. Frank riesce a nascondersi tra i boschi, dove si trova anche Ray Keene, un ex poliziotto in campeggio con il figlio Chris. Dopo averlo tratto in salvo, Ray vuole consegnarlo alla giustizia ma gli uomini di Cordell sono sulle loro tracce per liberarlo e portare a termine il loro incarico.

programme.title: The Bodyguard - Guardia del corpo
programme.desc: Esordio al cinema per Whitney Houston, con Kevin Costner in un cult romantico degli anni 90. Un ex federale viene incaricato di proteggere una popstar minacciata da un maniaco.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Fanta-action con Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall e Morgan Freeman. Ferito dai terroristi, uno studioso di intelligenza artificiale viene connesso a un computer e sviluppa poteri illimitati.

programme.desc: L'investigatore Jack Radcliff riceve una telefonata scioccante dalla nipote Ashley, recentemente assassinata. Lavorando insieme attraverso il tempo, corrono per risolvere il crimine prima che possa effettivamente accadere.

programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia di Guido Chiesa. Un uomo divorziato deve nascondere l'esistenza della figlia per conquistare una donna che detesta i bambini.

programme.title: Una notte a New York
programme.desc: Dakota Johnson e Sean Penn instaurano una connessione profonda in un film di rivelazioni e complicità, opera prima di Christy Hall. La conversazione fra una donna e un tassista nel tragitto dall'aeroporto JFK e Manhattan diventa un lungo dialogo sulle loro emozioni più intime.

programme.title: Fight Or Flight - Tensione ad alta quota
programme.desc: Un mercenario accetta l'incarico di rintracciare un contatto di alto valore a bordo di un volo internazionale. Rendendosi conto che a bordo dell'aereo vi sono assassini incaricati di uccidere entrambi, i due devono collaborare per sopravvivere.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Fanta-action con Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall e Morgan Freeman. Ferito dai terroristi, uno studioso di intelligenza artificiale viene connesso a un computer e sviluppa poteri illimitati.

programme.title: Io sono nessuno 2
programme.desc: L'assassino stacanovista Hutch Mansell porta la famiglia in vacanza. L'uomo si ritrova presto nel mirino del gestore di un parco divertimenti, di uno sceriffo losco e di un boss della malavita.

programme.title: Don't Let Go
programme.desc: L'investigatore Jack Radcliff riceve una telefonata scioccante dalla nipote Ashley, recentemente assassinata. Lavorando insieme attraverso il tempo, corrono per risolvere il crimine prima che possa effettivamente accadere.

programme.title: Cattiva coscienza
programme.desc: Divertente commedia romantica dal tocco fantastico con Francesco Scianna, Filippo Scicchitano, Matilde Gioli. Per salvare le nozze del suo protetto, una coscienza assume fattezze umane.

programme.title: Gran Turismo - La storia di un sogno impossibile
programme.desc: Corse adrenaliniche ispirate a una storia vera che vede al centro il celebre videogame. Un concorso per giocatori di 'Gran Turismo' diventa l'occasione della vita per un ragazzo.

programme.title: Hunting Season
programme.desc: Un padre iperprotettivo e la figlia dodicenne accolgono una giovane trovata sulla riva di un fiume. Le vite di padre e figlia cambiano per sempre con l'arrivo della sconosciuta.

programme.title: Francesca e Giovanni: Una storia d'amore e di mafia
programme.desc: Simona Izzo e Ricky Tognazzi raccontano la storia d'amore tra Francesca Morvillo e Giovanni Falcone: un rapporto intenso che li vedrà uniti fino agli ultimi istanti delle loro vite.

programme.title: Un bel giorno
programme.desc: Nuova commedia di successo per Fabio De Luigi e Virginia Raffaele. Tommaso, vedovo con quattro figlie, conosce Lara. L'incontro può cambiare tutto, ma entrambi nascondono qualcosa.

programme.title: Una notte a New York
programme.desc: Dakota Johnson e Sean Penn instaurano una connessione profonda in un film di rivelazioni e complicità, opera prima di Christy Hall. La conversazione fra una donna e un tassista nel tragitto dall'aeroporto JFK e Manhattan diventa un lungo dialogo sulle loro emozioni più intime.

programme.title: Come può uno scoglio
programme.desc: Torna la comicità dirompente di Pio e Amedeo ancora diretti da Gennaro Nunziante. La vita di Pio, avvocato dal carattere remissivo, viene stravolta dall'incontro con il vulcanico Amedeo.

programme.title: The Gentlemen
programme.desc: Brillante action di Guy Ritchie con Matthew McConaughey, Colin Farrell, Hugh Grant. La messa in vendita di una ricca attività illecita scatena gli appetiti di uomini senza scrupoli.

programme.title: Immaturi - Il viaggio
programme.desc: Commedia con Raoul Bova, Ambra Angiolini e Barbora Bobulova. Per celebrare la raggiunta maturita', gli amici scelgono una vacanza su un'isola greca, circondati da mille tentazioni.

programme.title: Maggie Moore(s) - Un omicidio di troppo
programme.desc: Commedia a tinte gialle targata Sky Original con Jon Hamm e Tina Fey. In una polverosa citta' dell'Arizona, il capo della polizia si trova alle prese con gli omicidi di due donne omonime.

programme.title: Cattive acque
programme.desc: Mark Ruffalo e Anne Hathaway in un dramma legale di impegno civile, tratto da una storia vera e diretto da Todd Haynes. Rischiando in prima persona, un coraggioso avvocato sfida una potente multinazionale accusandola di aver inquinato per anni l’acqua di una zona degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Le vele scarlatte
programme.desc: Pietro Marcello dirige Juliette Jouan e Louis Garrel dal romanzo di Aleksandr Grin. Normandia, primo dopoguerra: malvista da tutti nel villaggio una giovane sognatrice incontra l'amore.

programme.title: Il socio
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Grisham, thriller di Sydney Pollack con Gene Hackman e Tom Cruise. Assunto da un prestigioso studio legale, un avvocato inesperto viene coinvolto in loschi intrighi.

programme.title: Il Concorso
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Gugu Mbatha-Raw nel biopic su una storica battaglia femminista. Londra, 1970: il ‘Women's Liberation Movement’ irrompe in diretta televisiva durante il concorso per l’elezione di Miss Mondo in segno di protesta contro la strumentalizzazione delle donne.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.sub-title: Sale E Mare, Fuoco E Sangue
programme.desc: Spinta dalla fiducia che ripone in Alicent, Rhaenyra si prepara a conquistare Approdo del Re mentre la Triarchia salpa per affrontare Corlys nella Gola.

programme.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
programme.desc: Monumentale opera di Martin Scorsese con Leonardo DiCaprio e Robert De Niro. Una misteriosa serie di omicidi tra i nativi americani Osage obbliga il governo a intervenire.

programme.title: Lansky
programme.desc: Biopic con Harvey Keitel e Sam Worthington. Sotto custodia dell'FBI, l’anziano mafioso bielorusso Meyer Lansky, esponente del ‘Sindacato ebraico’, racconta la sua vita a un giornalista.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Ray
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al biopic su Ray Charles con Jamie Foxx. Dall'infanzia al successo, passando per i suoi controversi lati oscuri, la vita del leggendario "The Genius" della musica black.

programme.title: The Colour Room
programme.desc: Phoebe Dynevor nel biopic targato Sky Original, diretto da Claire McCarthy. La storia della rivoluzionaria artista della ceramica Clarice Cliff, una delle prime esponenti dell'Art Deco.

programme.title: Sully
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige un intenso biopic con Tom Hanks. Dopo aver salvato i passeggeri del suo aereo con una coraggiosa manovra, nel 2009 il capitano Sullenberger fu messo sotto accusa.

programme.title: Lee Miller
programme.desc: Racconto intenso sulla vita della fotografa Lee Miller, che esplora il costo emotivo del suo lavoro e il coraggio necessario per documentare la realtà brutale della guerra.

programme.title: Edtv
programme.desc: La rete True TV è in crisi. Al fine di aumentare gli ascolti la direttrice decide di seguire 24 ore su 24 la vita di un uomo normale, azione che porta a radicali cambiamenti all'esistenza del protagonista.

programme.title: Ennio Doris: C'e' anche domani
programme.desc: La storia del banchiere gentile Ennio Doris, fondatore di Banca Mediolanum. Da ragazzo che aveva un sogno a uomo d'oro della finanza italiana.

programme.title: Amata
programme.desc: Due donne affrontano lotte opposte per la fertilità: la giovane Nunzia è alle prese con una gravidanza indesiderata e desidera giorni spensierati, mentre Maddalena, a 40 anni, cerca disperatamente di concepire un figlio.

programme.title: Le ali della libertà
programme.desc: Tim Robbins e Morgan Freeman nel dramma carcerario tratto da Stephen King. Mentre sogna la fuga, un bancario condannato per omicidio stringe una grande amicizia con un altro detenuto.

programme.title: Non ci resta che piangere
programme.desc: Un maestro elementare e un bidello si ritrovano, per uno strano scherzo del caso, nel 1492. Decidono di recarsi a Palos, in Andalusia, per fermare Cristoforo Colombo e impedirgli di scoprire le Americhe.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Limonov
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Emmanuel Carrère, Kirill Serebrennikov dirige un film sulla travolgente vita dello scrittore e politico Eduard Limonov (Ben Whishaw) tra Russia, America ed Europa.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: La Grande Bellezza - Versione Integrale
programme.desc: Jep Gambardella, giornalista affermato, si muove tra i palazzi della Roma mondana in cui si celano vizio e degenerazione...

programme.title: No Other Choice - Non c'è altra scelta
programme.desc: Le contraddizioni della società coreana nel film di Park Chan-wook presentato a Venezia. Licenziato dopo 25 anni, un uomo vede andare in frantumi la sua vita "perfetta".

programme.title: Il talento di Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Sentimental Value
programme.desc: Nora e Agnes, due sorelle molto unite, si ritrovano a dover affrontare il ritorno del padre, regista carismatico ma assente nelle loro vite. L'uomo desidera realizzare il suo ultimo film e includere una delle figlie nel progetto.

programme.title: Il campione
programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Gioia mia
programme.desc: Gioia, un'insegnante di letteratura francese, instaura un legame proibito, fragile e inspiegabilmente necessario con Alessio, un suo studente. Quest'ultimo però distrugge tutto e cancella l'unica persona che lo abbia mai amato.

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.sub-title: Sale E Mare, Fuoco E Sangue
programme.desc: Spinta dalla fiducia che ripone in Alicent, Rhaenyra si prepara a conquistare Approdo del Re mentre la Triarchia salpa per affrontare Corlys nella Gola.

programme.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
programme.desc: Joaquin Phoenix riveste i panni del folle personaggio della DC Comics in uno sbalorditivo sequel con Lady Gaga. Internato nel manicomio di Arkham in attesa del processo per i crimini commessi, Arthur Fleck si innamora di Lee Quinzel, una paziente affascinata dalla figura del Joker.

programme.title: Dumb Money
programme.desc: Diretto da Craig Gillespie, il financial drama che ripercorre il caso GameStop, l'azienda salvata da un gruppo di investitori amatoriali a discapito di un gruppo di speculatori di Wall Street.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: Le musiche di Eddie Vedder e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Un diciottenne lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un intimo viaggio a contatto con la natura.

programme.title: Il professore e il pinguino
programme.desc: Un insegnante di inglese disilluso si reca in Argentina nel 1976 per insegnare. Si trova di fronte a una classe di ragazzi turbolenti e a un Paese nel caos. Quando salva un pinguino da una spiaggia inquinata dal petrolio, tutto cambia.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: La magnifica Lillian Hall
programme.desc: Jessica Lange, Kathy Bates, Jesse Williams e Pierce Brosnan nella toccante pellicola che racconta il crepuscolo di una diva di Broadway.

programme.title: Codice d'onore
programme.desc: Tom Cruise sfida Jack Nicholson in un dramma giudiziario con Demi Moore e Kevin Bacon. Tre avvocati militari difendono due marines accusati dell'omicidio di un commilitone.

programme.title: La battaglia di Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al War movie di Mel Gibson con Andrew Garfield, da una storia vera. Seconda guerra mondiale: un soldato ottiene la medaglia al valore malgrado il rifiuto di impugnare le armi.

programme.title: Il quadro rubato
programme.desc: André Masson, esperto di arte moderna, riceve una lettera in cui si dice che un dipinto di Egon Schiele è stato trovato a Mulhouse. Dell'opera era scomparsa ogni traccia ormai dal 1939.

programme.title: Old Boy
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per il film pulp di Park Chan-Wook. Un uomo, segregato in una stanza per quindici anni, cerca vendetta nei confronti del suo sconosciuto aguzzino.

programme.title: Una notte da leoni 2
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Joker", Bradley Cooper nel celebre sequel di sbornie e avventura. Riunitasi in Thailandia per le nozze di Stu, la gang si ritrova catapultata in una spirale di disastri.

programme.title: Una notte da leoni 3
programme.desc: Torna Bradley Cooper con i suoi pazzi compagni di avventura in un'altra folle notte. Il quartetto di amici finisce in un vortice di incredibili imprevisti dopo un inaspettato sequestro.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci portano alla scoperta della trilogia "Una notte da leoni", disponibile da sabato 21 a lunedi' 23 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Una notte da leoni
programme.desc: Notte brava a Las Vegas per Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms e Zach Galifianakis. Per rintracciare il promesso sposo scomparso i suoi amici ripercorrono le tappe della folle notte appena trascorsa.

programme.title: Into Darkness - Star Trek

programme.title: Dragon Trainer - Il mondo nascosto
programme.desc: Terzo toccante capitolo della trilogia di successo targata DreamWorks. La minaccia di Grimmel il Grifagno costringe Hiccup e Sdentato a partire verso un luogo leggendario.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Un gioiello di animazione diventato un classico. Un leone, una giraffa, un ippopotamo e una zebra evadono dallo zoo di New York per vivere rocambolesche avventure nella giungla.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: Avventurosa fiaba fantasy con Michelle Pfeiffer, Charlie Cox e Robert De Niro. Un ragazzo entra in un regno magico per catturare la stella cadente che ha promesso alla sua amata.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Dall’omonimo bestseller, Julia Roberts e Owen Wilson nella toccante pellicola che ha conquistato il pubblico. Un bambino affetto da una rara malformazione combatte per essere accettato.

programme.title: Biancaneve
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e' la Regina Cattiva in un'irriverente versione della famosa fiaba. Dopo la morte del padre, Biancaneve deve affrontare la perfida matrigna. Sara' aiutata da 7 nanetti briganti.

programme.title: Rosanero
programme.desc: Andrea Porporati dirige Salvatore Esposito in una commedia per tutta la famiglia targata Sky Original. Al risveglio dal coma, una bambina si ritrova nel corpo di un boss e viceversa.

programme.title: E.T. L'extra-terrestre
programme.desc: 4 Oscar all'emozionante capolavoro di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un bambino protegge dagli scienziati un alieno rimasto sulla Terra e lo aiuta a tornare sul suo pianeta.

programme.title: I viaggiatori
programme.desc: Avventuroso viaggio nel tempo targato Sky Original. Un gruppo di adolescenti alla ricerca di un fratello scomparso, viene catapultato nella Roma del 1939 sull'orlo del conflitto mondiale.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulle pellicole prodotte da Illumination.

programme.title: Tom & Jerry
programme.desc: Le origini di una storica rivalità in una pellicola che mescola animazione classica e live action. Il topo Jerry si trasferisce in un hotel di New York per assistere alle nozze del secolo, costringendo l'organizzatore dell'evento ad assumere il gatto Tom per liberarsene.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Biancaneve
